pages.title: Herbivore / Carnivore / Omnivore
pages.text: Every animal has a diet:$(br)$(bold)Herbivores$() eat only plants — crops, seeds, hay, apples, sugar.$(br2)$(bold)Carnivores$() eat only meat and fish.$(br2)$(bold)Omnivores$() eat everything.$(br2)Not sure what a mob eats? With Jade installed, look at it to see its diet; admins can also check and change diets with the $(l:animalflee:commands/commands_overview)diet commands$().

pages.title: Meat & Fish
pages.text: Meat and fish are detected using vanilla tags plus NeoForge's common 'c:' tags, so modded meat and fish are recognized automatically.

Wolves are carnivores. Feed them raw or cooked meat, or fish.$(br2)Feeding a horse a poisonous potato can still poison it.$(br2)To make another item count as animal food, use the $(l:animalflee:commands/commands_overview)custom food commands$(); different foods restore different amounts.
